intro:
The following are original skills in Project Diablo 2 provided by items or set bonuses that are not otherwise available to any classes via skill points.
These skills are either OSkills or skills cast automatically by item affixes. For more information see: Skills on Items

Blade Dance is a modified version of Whirlwind. It hits once every 0.2 seconds (5 frames) when using a single weapon or twice every 0.2 seconds when dual-wielding.

Blade Dance is categorized as an Assassin Martial Arts skill; in addition to "+X to All Skills", it also benefits from "+X to Assassin Skills" and "+X to Martial Arts (Assassin Only)" affixes.

Changelog

Season 12:

  • Now deals damage every 5th frame instead of every 4th.
  • Base enhanced damage reduced from 40% to 30%.
  • Enhanced damage per level reduced from 5% to 4%.

Season 10:

  • Base Enhanced Damage from +80% to +40%.
  • Base Enhanced Damage per level reduced from +8% to +5%.
    • Note: We wanted to maintain the power of Blade Dance Assassins but transition that power away from raw physical damage and more into the poison thematic.

Season 9:

  • Base damage reduced from 110% to 80%.
  • Enhanced damage per level reduced from 10% to 8%.

Season 7:

  • Base damage increased from 60% to 110%.
  • Base attack rating increased from 90% to 200%.
  • Attack rating per level increased from 6% to 15%.

Season 6:

  • Base enhanced damage bonus increased from 30% to 60%.
  • Enhanced damage per level increased from 4% to 10%.
  • Now counts as a Martial Arts skill and benefits from + to Martial Arts skills, + All Skills and + to Assassin skills.

Season 5:

  • Skill added (same as Whirlwind except it hits 1 frame faster).
  • Base velocity bonus increased from 0% to 20% (patch 6).
  • No longer locks the player in animation on level up (patch 6).

  • Recharge charges recharge 200% faster in PvP arenas (for example Blink on Enigma).

  • Enigma Blink changed to 5 charges from 3.

skills.name: Vampire Form
skills.body:
Vampire Form in Project Diablo 2 is an active, castable transformation like Werewolf or other shapeshifting skills.

This skill changes your character's physical appearance into a Vampire, and grants the following while transformed:

Season 11:

  • Introduced.
  • Grants +20% poison damage, +30% magic damage, +40% faster cast rate, you may apply an additional curse and 10 life after each kill (these bonuses are likely to be changed during beta as we are still iterating).
